datasets.name: DebitCurrencyData
datasets.sql:
select
  currency.valute as ID,
  currency.val_name as SName,
  currency.valu_name as Name,
  rates.OSTAT as Rate
from
  avalute currency,
  TEMPRATE rates
where
  rates.VAL_KOD = currency.VALUTE
order by currency.valute

datasets.name: Transactions
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  p.ID,
  P.rowid,
  p.OP_ID as OperatorID,
  p.no_prov as OperationNo,
  p.dat as TransactionDate,
  p.DEBT as DebitID,
  ad.ACC_NO as DebitAccNo,
  p.VAL_ACC as DebitCurrencyID,
  dc.val_name as DebitCurrencySName,
  ad.filial as DebitBranch,
  p.KREDIT as CreditID,
  ac.ACC_NO as CreditAccNo,
  p.CurrencyID_C as CreditCurrencyID,
  cc.val_name as CreditCurrencySName,
  ac.filial as CreditBranch,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.Ammount_C as CreditAmount,
  p.LAmmount as LAmount,
  p.Rate_D as DebitRate,
  p.Rate_C as CreditRate,
  p.Bank_D as DebitBank,
  p.Bank_K as CreditBank,
  p.NO_PACK as PackageNumber,
  p.SHIFR as CYPHERCODE,
  sb_expertanalyse.getoperationtype(p.vid_op, p.val_acc, p.currencyID_c) as OPERATIONCODE,
  p.Kassa_B as INBALANCECHAR,
  p.Kassa_Z as OUTBALANCECHAR,
  p.NO_FILIAL as FilialID,
  ad.bal_cn1 as DebitBalance,
  p.Name,
  sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.op_id) as usr ,
  sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.commit_opid) as usrcommit ,
  0 as Flags,
  2 as status,
  '' as REJECT_REASON,
  ad.kli_id dcustid,
  ac.kli_id ccustid
FROM
    out_account ad,
    out_account ac,
    avalute dc,
    avalute cc,
    out_provarch p
where
    p.dat =:TransactionDate
    and (ad.ID = p.DEBT)
    and (ac.ID = p.KREDIT)
    and (ad.val_acc = p.val_acc)
    and (ac.val_acc = p.CurrencyID_C)
    and (dc.VALUTE = p.val_acc)
    and (cc.VALUTE = p.CurrencyID_C)
--    and ((P.OP_ID<>-1 and
  --        not EXISTS(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0)))
    --      or
      --    (P.OP_ID in(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0))))

union all

SELECT
  p.ID,
  P.rowid,
  p.OP_ID as OperatorID,
  p.no_prov as OperationNo,
  p.dat as TransactionDate,
  p.DEBT as DebitID,
  ad.ACC_NO as DebitAccNo,
  p.VAL_ACC as DebitCurrencyID,
  dc.val_name as DebitCurrencySName,
  ad.filial as DebitBranch,
  p.KREDIT as CreditID,
  ac.ACC_NO as CreditAccNo,
  p.CurrencyID_C as CreditCurrencyID,
  cc.val_name as CreditCurrencySName,
  ac.filial as CreditBranch,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.Ammount_C as CreditAmount,
  p.LAmmount as LAmount,
  p.Rate_D as DebitRate,
  p.Rate_C as CreditRate,
  p.Bank_D as DebitBank,
  p.Bank_K as CreditBank,
  p.NO_PACK as PackageNumber,
  p.SHIFR as CYPHERCODE,
  sb_expertanalyse.getoperationtype(p.vid_op, p.val_acc, p.currencyID_c) as OPERATIONCODE,
  p.Kassa_B as INBALANCECHAR,
  p.Kassa_Z as OUTBALANCECHAR,
  p.NO_FILIAL as FilialID,
  ad.bal_cn1 as DebitBalance,
  p.Name,
  sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.op_id) as usr ,
  '' as usrcommit , 
  0 as Flags,
  decode(Rejected, 0, 1, 3) as status,
  RejectReason as REJECT_REASON,
ad.kli_id dcustid,
  ac.kli_id ccustid
FROM
    out_account ad,
    out_account ac,
    avalute dc,
    avalute cc,
    out_LAZYTRANSACTION p
where
    p.dat =:TransactionDate
    and (ad.ID = p.DEBT)
    and (ac.ID = p.KREDIT)
    and (dc.VALUTE = p.val_acc)
    and (cc.VALUTE = p.CurrencyID_C)
  --  and ((P.OP_ID<>-1 and
    --      not EXISTS(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0)))
      --    or
        --  (P.OP_ID in(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0))))

datasets.name: Commission
datasets.sql:
select
    id
   ,name
   ,debt
   ,out_sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(debt) as DebitAccount
   ,out_sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(debt) as DebitCurrency
   ,out_sb_complex_transactions.getaccountcurrencyid(debt) as DebitCurrencyID
   ,credit
   ,out_sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(credit) as CreditAccount
   ,out_sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(credit) as CreditCurrency
   ,out_sb_complex_transactions.getaccountcurrencyid(credit) as CreditCurrencyID   
   ,additionalDebt
   ,out_sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(additionalDebt) as ADebitAccount
   ,out_sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(additionalDebt) as ADebitCurrency
   ,out_sb_complex_transactions.getaccountcurrencyid(additionalDebt) as AddDebitCurrencyID      
   ,additionalCredit
   ,out_sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(additionalCredit) as ACreditAccount
   ,out_sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(additionalCredit) as ACreditCurrency
   ,out_sb_complex_transactions.getaccountcurrencyid(additionalCredit) as AddCreditCurrencyID         
   ,assignment
   ,commisionassignment
   ,UserID   
from
    commision_trans
where
   UserID = 0 or
    UserID = (SBLogin.UserID)
order by
    name
